description: This file contains validation functions for Open Fronthaul Radio Unit configuration, including port duplication checks, transmission window validation, scaling parameter validation, and overall RU configuration validation.

methods.name: validate_duplicated_ports
methods.description: Checks if the given ports contain duplicates.

methods.name: validate_transmission_window
methods.description: Validates if the transmission window duration exceeds the symbol duration.

methods.name: validate_scaling_params
methods.description: Validates scaling parameters for correctness and range.

methods.name: validate_ru_ofh_unit_config
methods.description: Validates individual RU unit configuration including port counts and scaling.

methods.name: validate_hal_config
methods.description: Validates hardware abstraction layer configuration, especially DPDK arguments.

methods.name: validate_ru_ofh_config
methods.description: Main function to validate overall RU configuration against cell validation configs.
